title: PreferredHandlers
description: One person's choice of which platform opens which ontology — the W3DS analogue of OS default apps, on their OWN vault (ACL = self). Keyed by ontology schemaId: `handlers[<schemaId>] = {openUrl, platform?}` where `openUrl` is a template another platform may navigate to when the person taps an envelope of that ontology. One envelope per owner; writes merge one key at a time.

openUrl.description: URL template that opens this ontology in the chosen platform

platform.description: Human label of the chosen platform (informational)
